d:
Cancer changes more than the person diagnosed. It can disrupt work, finances, families, and the everyday life around them.
Access to the right care can change that journey - from finding cancer early and supporting treatment to helping patients live with dignity when treatment is no longer about a cure.
Through its work with healthcare institutions and communities, Alkem Foundation is working to make quality cancer care more accessible and more complete.
In partnership with Alkem Foundation
